title: Electron transfer in catalysis: from fundamentals to strategies
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00600C, Tutorial Review
Xiaoning Li, Xinwei Guan, Lingfeng Zhu, Hui Li, Xiaofeng Yin, Shujie Sun, Haimei Xu, Yameng Fan, Peng Li, Long Hu, Zhijun Wu, Hongge Pan, Xiaolin Wang, Zhenxiang Cheng, Baohua Jia, Tianyi Ma
This tutorial review bridges fundamental electron attributes with catalytic mechanisms, offering a unified framework to guide catalyst design and highlight the untapped potential of spin in advancing energy technologies.
